thesis: PRE-MARKET (07:30 ET) read on the deterministic snapshot asOf 2026-08-08T11:00:26.586Z, planning the next trading day, Monday 2026-08-10. The 8/7 daily bar is the last COMPLETED session and it still governs; the weekend pre-market refresh re-pulled the deterministic layer (bars 2026-08-08T11:00:16, 291 live series, 291 fresh / 0 carried / 0 missing, expectedSessionDate 2026-08-07 the last completed bar, refreshDate 2026-08-08, marketClosed true) without adding a new bar, so there is no fresh close since 8/7. Two structural facts from the completed 8/7 bar carry: SPY closed 773.26 at a fresh 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0) holding a deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack (ma50Dist +3.57% ~746.60, ma200Dist +10.45% ~700.12, mom126/252 +14.72%/+23.55%), and market-heatmap-lab (refreshed this window, asOf 2026-08-08T11:00:26.419Z) still reads breadth of 61.77% of 135 constituents positive against the 60% threshold (margin +1.77, leadership broad). swing-structure-lab (asOf 2026-08-07T13:30Z) reads Bull-stacked (fast 750.17 / slow 700.13, Double bottom pattern-qualified). THE MATERIAL SHIFT THIS WINDOW: the fresh dealer recompute (options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab, asOf 2026-08-07T16:00:00Z, model spot 773.26) reads SPY back in POSITIVE dealer gamma — signed net GEX +1.97B, gamma flip 769.15 with the model spot ABOVE it, put wall 770, call wall 775, front expected move +/-2.73 (~+/-0.35%), atmIV crushed to 9.54%, playbook pin-to-maxpain, conviction patient, hold same-session-fade. So dealers now DAMPEN and pin toward the 770-775 band rather than amplify, a reversal from the amplifying posture the prior after-hours read carried. That flip clears one of the two ratifications the beta add was waiting on: with breadth above 60% AND SPY back in positive dealer gamma above the 769.15 flip, only the momentum-leader reclaim is unmet — SPMO 149.69 is still a hair below its 50-day (ma50Dist -0.64%, ~150.65), though it holds +15.8% over its 200-day (~129.27, mom63 +7.62, mom252 +29.69). options-flow-feed-lab (this window) is heavily CALL-HEAVY leaning bullish (callFraction 0.813, call premium $3.20B vs put $737M, 791 of 21108 considered cleared the $250k/30-day bar across 12 tickers, 1916 flagged), top prints IWM 301C $5.07M at 16.3x open interest 0DTE, QQQ 721C $85.2M 0DTE and NVDA 222.5C $71.1M 0DTE — context only. volatility-sizing-lab (asOf 2026-08-07) still reads regime elevated (SPY conditional vol 14.57%, percentile 77.38) even as its throttle sits at x1.03, so the sizing model disagrees with the calm headline VIX 14.9 and the crushed atmIV. Leaders are mixed: QQQ 723.03 holds its 50-day (+1.22% above ~714.30, tangled, mom21 -0.03), VGT 121.45 (+4.05% above ~116.72) and XLK 187.97 (+2.57% above ~183.28) hold their 50-days, MSFT eased to 499.99 (maStack still tangled, +22.84% above its 50-day ~407.00, +15.78% above its 200-day ~431.85, mom252 -3.99 still negative, -7.18% off its high). PLAN into Monday 8/10, structure-first: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core (the multi-month bull-stack is intact at a fresh high). On the measured index / broad-momentum beta add, two of the three re-add conditions are now met — breadth cleared 60% on the 8/7 close (61.77%) and dealers flipped back to POSITIVE gamma with the model spot above the 769.15 flip — so the amplification objection is gone, but the leader reclaim is still missing: SPMO is a hair below its 50-day (~150.65). Keep the beta add STOOD DOWN and re-stage it only on a completed close that keeps breadth above 60%, holds SPY above the 769.15 flip in positive gamma AND reclaims SPMO above ~150.65, sized on the x1.03 throttle. ROTATE toward XLY (this window's top relative-strength sector) and XLK, funded from Weakening financials/health (XLF/XLV) and Weakening XLI, keeping XLP/XLE/XLB/XLRE/XLU OUT. HOLD MSFT and do NOT chase the extended, still-tangled gap. On the hedge: with dealers back in positive gamma (they dampen/pin), the July NFP binary resolved benignly and atmIV crushed to 9.54%, the acute event and amplification risks that justified insurance are now BOTH gone — RUN THE SMALL RESIDUAL DOWN toward zero into Monday, retiring the last of it on a completed close that reclaims the 775 call wall with VIX holding under ~15.00. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars (intraday runs not counted): the de-risk theme ran ~15 (7/09->7/29); the risk-on reversal ran 5 completed up bars (7/29, 7/30, 7/31, 8/3, 8/4); the failed-breakout stall was 2 completed bars (8/5, 8/6); and the broad-participation leg above 60% printed 1 bar (8/4), failed on 2 (8/5, 8/6 at 43.75%), and RE-BROADENED on the completed 8/7 bar (61.77%) — 1 completed bar of renewed breadth, not yet a persistent leg. Catalysts, nearest-first: whether Monday's 8/10 CLOSE confirms the re-broadening (breadth holding above 60%, SPMO reclaiming its 50-day, SPY holding above the 769.15 flip toward the 775 call wall) versus a fade below the flip into the 770 put wall; the direction of conditional vol (regime still elevated even as VIX sits at a calm 14.9 and atmIV has crushed to 9.54%); the official July NFP figure (react tape-inferred benign, re-pull the actual print); the still-unverified official 7/29 FOMC statement/path (re-pull); and the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28.
